notes: ADR-0235: optionable US stocks and their per-session total option volume over the last 20 exchange sessions up to `end` (pinned so a re-run totals the same sessions). Streams: underlyings, chain_volume. Alpaca has no ETF flag, so exclude_name_regex drops names that read as funds, trusts, notes, units, warrants or preferreds; widen or narrow it here, never in code. Contracts are listed active AND inactive so weeklies that expired inside the window still count. Feed `indicative` is a subset of OPRA trades: levels are partial, the ranking is what this pull is for. Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source option-activity --catalog-source option-activity --connector dskit.onboarding.libs.alpaca:AlpacaOptionActivityConnector --config @configs/source-option-activity.json --activate --root <root>; then acquire --source option-activity --stream underlyings|chain_volume --mode backfill. Credentials are the named environment variables, never config.
